The '''''Ambush at Sul-34''''' was an attack on the Rebel fleet to delay the Rebel Assault on Endor long enough for Palpatine to ready his forces for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Prelude==
After [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] had completed his reconnaissance mission at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] Summit at the [[Delfii system/Legends|Delfii system]]. He had confirmed to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] that the Rebels had taken the bait to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] new [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], believing it to be under construction and unguarded. In reality, the Death Star was fully operational and armed, although still under construction and that the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was hiding and laying in wait to destroy the Rebel Fleet. Stele was then assigned to delay the Rebels for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to prepare for the upcoming battle. To that end he was to destroy the first three starships that arrive at Nav buoy [[Sul-34]]. The [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] wanted Stele to destroy a large portion of starfighters so that the Alliance would have to commit all of their reinforcements and leave nothing in reserve.

==The Battle==
Stele arrived at Sul-34 to find a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]] ''[[Red Dog]]'' present with [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] after dealing with the starfighters two more medium ships arrived and launched their own fighters. After the ''Red Dog'' was destroyed by Stele, he and his wingmen destroyed multiple starfighters and the two starships, with a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transport]] [[Resupply]] to reload his fighter with more [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] should he need more bombs and missiles. With the destruction of the ships he was permitted to return or do more damage to the Rebel Convoy which included a [[Container transport]] ''[[Dakkrakk]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] ''[[Asis]]'' 3 [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvettes]] ''[[Floran]]''.

==Aftermath==
The destruction of many starships forced the Rebels to delay the attack and collect more forces for their frontline assault, allowing time for Palpatine to oversee the construction of the Death Star and ensure that the Rebels were destroyed.

Stele for his performance was awarded the [[Medal of Guile]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' as Battle 12, Mission 7: Delay Strike Force. This article assumes completion of all "Primary" and "Secondary" mission objectives as there are no "Bonus" objectives and the only reason to continue destroying the later ships is to increase the player's score.

The two capital ships that arrive depend on which fighters the player eliminates. If the Player destroys the A-wings, two [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]]s ''[[Shmus]]'' and ''[[Barker]]'' arrive. If the player destroys the X-wings, a [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] ''[[War Pig]]'' and a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack-class light cruiser]] ''[[Lsumu]]'' arrive.
